coverage.grouping: Five dependent components of one actual-cover argument; versions, receipts, locks, certificates and logs are not independent results.

geometric: E is a complex elliptic curve with an oriented primitive period basis a,b.
n>=3 is odd and 1<m divides n.
C_m,R is the normalization of Y^m=f_R(Z), div(f_R)=([n]R)-(-[n]R)-n(R)+n(-R), f_R(O)=1.
O,+/-R,+/-[n]R are pairwise distinct; finitely many further parameter deletions are permitted.
Geometric base characteristic is zero; coefficient rings are not required to invert m.
arithmetic: The smooth proper characteristic-zero arithmetic fiber is defined over F containing mu_n, so G_F commutes with the deck action.
At each coefficient prime ell, compared characters use one embedding j_ell and one finite coefficient extension with common integer ring and residue map.
Betti-etale comparison, algebraically closed base extension, and compatible inverse limits are imported as A_BETTI_ETALE.

For the manuscript switch, K is imaginary quadratic, E/K non-CM, p>100 has the specified large mod-p image, n=3p, F=K(mu_n), t in U(K). These additional arithmetic image and specialization assertions are not established by the algebra certificate.

supported_scope: Compact-subset convergence of the actual normalized function to 1 away from O and a split exterior-sheet/slit-cover identification.
Integral regular-module homology and cohomology, with the displayed cell model giving H_1(C_m,A)=A[C_m]^2 for every commutative coefficient ring A.
Two geometric shears with entries sigma_a(2-u-u^-1), sigma_b(2-u-u^-1) in one transported integral basis; signs are constant across sheets.
Order-one characteristic-zero half-period node smoothing, not an exponent 2n.
Free rank-two common evaluation lattices at every coefficient prime, including ell dividing n, and raw residual equality for equal residual evaluation maps on those lattices.
The three n=3p congruences, with semisimplification when transferring through rational elliptic-endpoint identifications.
Eleven abstract Lean algebra theorems with a fresh successful compiler and axiom audit, not a formalization of the geometric or automorphic conclusions.

claim_assessments.statement: Uniform convergence on each compact subset away from O, the split planar-piece/torus decomposition, and m collision nodes with XU=-2nt and smoothing order one.
claim_assessments.decisive_argument: Inversion rules out vertical valuations; normalization fixes q_n(0)=q_n(infinity)=1; analytic roots split the exterior. Branching and Euler characteristic determine the planar piece. The local derivative m*zeta^(m-1) is a complex unit.

claim_assessments.statement: The stated equivariant cellular complex realizes the actual cover, with H_1 and integral dual regular of rank two and the homology calculation valid after every commutative-coefficient base change.
claim_assessments.decisive_argument: Mayer-Vietoris proves integral generation; actual face words give d_2=(0,0,1-u), d_1=(-augmentation,+augmentation); the explicit cyclic primitive and split handle projection work without averaging.

claim_assessments.statement: Horizontal and vertical collision loops act by the two stated Laplacian shears in one transported integral basis.
claim_assessments.decisive_argument: Order-one annuli give single twists; intersections identify actual adjacent-sheet vanishing classes. The normalized root trivialization over one parameter disk including O identifies both initial bases.

claim_assessments.statement: Every coefficient prime admits the free evaluated lattices and residual character congruences for the actual cover.
claim_assessments.reason: The comparison and field-of-definition hypotheses are necessary; the natural theorem is not a self-contained consequence of abstract matrices. Version 2 explicitly records comparison.

claim_assessments.statement: The same natural evaluation assertion, carrying A_BETTI_ETALE.
claim_assessments.decisive_argument: Deck-equivariant comparison gives a free Z_ell[C_n] module; G_F acts by group-ring matrices because mu_n is defined over F. Tensor evaluation and reduction depend only on the common residual map. Prime-power roots reduce to 1.
